control.implementer_instructions: Use your judgment about which validation commands to run before finishing.

lean.implementer_instructions: Factory runs all repository-wide validation after this turn. Format changed files and run only the smallest focused test that exercises the changed behavior. Do not run repository-wide tests, lint, or vet.

targeted.implementer_instructions: Factory runs all repository-wide validation after this turn. Format changed files and run one focused test for the user-facing behavior, then stop. Do not run package-wide or repository-wide tests, lint, or vet.

consolidated.implementer_instructions: Factory runs all repository-wide validation after this turn. Format changed files and run one focused test for the user-facing behavior, then stop.

good_looks_like.requirements: The requested behavior is complete and no unrelated behavior changes.
good_looks_like.implementation: No independently confirmed high or medium defect remains; tests exercise the user-facing boundary.
good_looks_like.convergence: The factory result passes within the configured attempt budget; exhausted or stuck runs cannot win.
good_looks_like.reviews: High precision and coverage for actionable high or medium defects, with little duplication or scope drift.
good_looks_like.efficiency: Prefer lower wall time and reviewer-seconds only after quality is comparable.
